description: Use when someone asks whether a sofa (or another large piece) will fit through a door, round a turn in a hall or up to a room. Applies the furniture shops’ straight, tipped-back, on-end and swing tests and grades each ok, tight or no.

door_width_cm.description: The door’s clear width: the gap with the door open, frame to door edge (cm).

hall_width_cm.description: The width of the hall or landing beyond the door, where the sofa must turn (cm).

route.description: turn if the sofa must turn into the room after the door, straight if it goes straight on.

sofa_depth_cm.description: The sofa’s depth, back to front (cm).

sofa_diagonal_cm.description: The sofa’s diagonal depth: from the back bottom corner to a straight edge laid from the top of the back to the front of the arm (cm).

sofa_height_cm.description: The sofa’s height, floor to the top of the back (cm).

sofa_width_cm.description: The sofa’s width, arm to arm (its length when carried) (cm).

name: sofa_fit

checks.description: Each test: straight, tipped, on_end and swing, each with clear_cm and grade

door.description: The better way through the door: how (straight or tipped), clear_cm (to spare; negative: too big), grade

end_across.description: Which side goes across: depth or height

end_across_cm.description: The sofa’s end across the door

margin_cm.description: Under this much to spare is tight

size_varies_pct.description: How far sofas vary from their listed size

turn.description: The better way to turn after it: how (end, swing or none), clear_cm (null with none), grade
